lines: Seed with nor head nor tail, abloom, mid-tithi set —
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśaṃ nityamabhyaset |
